TaskDescription: Passive listening to spoken Mandarin Chinese words (44 categories), Mandarin Chinese digits (0-9) and English words (20 categories), 2 s per word (Zhang et al. 2025).
ManufacturersModelName: EEG-1200 (acquisition at 1000 Hz; this file is a 200 Hz derivative)

LFS feature extraction (authors, Zhang e.Description: low-frequency signal: low-pass 100 Hz (anti-aliasing), downsampled to 200 Hz, normalised within each 2 s window

iEEGReference: bipolar, applied after removing contacts with epileptiform activity (paper); the contact pairs are not given in the release
iEEGElectrodeInfo: platinum-iridium SEEG shafts, 0.8 mm diameter, 3.5 mm inter-contact distance, 10-16 contacts (paper)
Description: Authors' per-trial feature arrays (LFS), one 2 s epoch per trial in release order.
